description: Dedicated HGRApi tool for GET api/ChannelListing/getSettings. This is an explicit tool with a fixed endpoint; it is not a generic endpoint caller. HGRApi functional documentation: Purpose: Provides the GET get settings operation in published product creation and optimization. Use when: Use it when a client needs to run the get settings operation for published product creation and optimization. Input: [FromQuery] sourceId: int. [FromQuery] sourcePrice: decimal. Header channel: current ChannelOAuthId. Output: Returns the result or applies the effect of the get settings operation. Search terms: channellisting getsettings. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

channelOAuthId.description: ChannelOAuthId returned by hgr_list_channels for the selected visible store.

name: hgr_get_channellisting_getsettings
title: Get Channellisting Getsettings
